test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_min_max_index_perf ( a Array(UInt64), i256 Array(Int256), d256 Array(Decimal256(0)) ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_min_max_index_perf SELECT arrayMap(x -> if(x = number % 256, toUInt64(1000), x), range(256)), arrayMap(x -> toInt256(if(x = number % 256, 1000, x)), range(256)), arrayMap(x -> toDecimal256(if(x = number % 256, 1000, x), 0), range(256)) FROM numbers(10000)
test.query: SELECT sum(arrayMinIndex(a) + arrayMaxIndex(a)) FROM array_min_max_index_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(indexOf(a, arrayMin(a)) + indexOf(a, arrayMax(a))) FROM array_min_max_index_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(arrayMinIndex(i256) + arrayMaxIndex(i256)) FROM array_min_max_index_perf FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(arrayMinIndex(d256) + arrayMaxIndex(d256)) FROM array_min_max_index_perf FORMAT Null
